title: Ocean Fresh Canadian Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Canadian dish featuring galangal and clay pot cooking, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This keto friendly stew is made with fresh ocean fish and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: cod fish
ingredients.notes: fresh and cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large clay pot, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sliced galangal and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cod fish pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the clay pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the stew is hot and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
